decisions.why: Examples include semperguard® sapphire (nitrile), semperguard® vinyl comfort™, and sempermed® product lines spanning nitrile and vinyl examination gloves
Semperit medical PPE glove products (Sempertip, sempermed® syntegra X, Semperclean®) are specialised medical examination/protective gloves
Dental examination gloves including semperguard® and sempermed® brands are dental consumables for use in dental procedures
sempermed® syntegra DPG-free range (preCision, IR, green, UV) are nitrile examination gloves without phthalate plasticisers
sempermed® supreme brand gloves with QuickDon™ technology are latex examination gloves with quick-donning feature
sempermed® syntegra CR is a nitrile examination glove from Semperit's medical line
